_comment: The venue atlas — every place the slate can stage a card, and what that place does to the EYE. Keyed by the slate's own venue strings (run-core's entryValid already owns that identity; a second id would be a second name for the same fact). Everything in here is a LENS: light tints the stage, air drifts through it, and the card text says where you are — none of it reaches the rules, the record, or the certificate, and the harness proves a replay cannot see it. KESTREL YARD's light values are the yard's own pre-atlas constants, so the house look IS the look that always existed. A venue with count 0 air is an authored stillness, not a missing decision.

KESTREL YARD.title: KESTREL YARD — LATTICE RELAY STATION
KESTREL YARD.framing: A Lattice contract, turned card: the Syndicate crew knew you were coming, and the book opened an hour ago.
present: tripod on the north wall — this card is recorded, and the record is the match
wants the relay back; hosts under protest

THE COLD COURT.title: THE COLD COURT — COVENANT SANCTUARY GROUND
THE COLD COURT.framing: The Covenant sanctions this card and holds the line it draws: what their rules forbid tonight is forbidden to everyone, including the house.
present: reads the sanction aloud before the first move, and again if anyone forgets
unarmed on principle, and nobody tests the principle
tripod in the cold — the record is the match

LATTICE FLOOR 9.title: LATTICE FLOOR 9 — PRIORITY FREIGHT DECK
LATTICE FLOOR 9.framing: The Lattice keeps the lights on and the lights are on you: this card runs on their floor, their power, and their schedule, and the freight resumes the moment it ends.
present: has the freight manifest and a deadline; you are the delay
watching the cabling, not the fight
book open, visiting under a freight pass

THE DRAIN.title: THE DRAIN — THE PIPE NOBODY MAPS
THE DRAIN.framing: Nobody signs the Drain. The card exists because everyone here says it doesn't, and half the colors in the crowd are borrowed.
present: took the book an hour ago; was never here
false colors are legal tender below the waterline
found a dry ledge anyway; the record does not need permission

TERMINAL WEST.title: TERMINAL WEST — WANDERER DEPOT, WIND OFF THE FLATS
TERMINAL WEST.framing: Wanderer ground under a Covenant sanction: the road hosts, the line holds, and everything you do here travels to the next town ahead of you.
present: hosting between departures; the yard is a yard again at dawn
the sanction rode in with the caravan
leaves at close, and the story leaves with them

THE ARCHIVE PIT.title: THE ARCHIVE PIT — WITNESS READING FLOOR
THE ARCHIVE PIT.framing: The Witnesses sanction almost nothing. They sanctioned this: a card fought on the reading floor, because some records are made better than they are told.
present: one for each angle; disagreement between them is itself recorded
book open, voice low, deeply uncomfortable
